title: Simplices and Regular Polygonal Tori in Euclidean Ramsey Theory
author: Miltiadis Karamanlis

version_comparison.scope: All seven pages visually compared. Mathematical statements and constructions retain their form; observed changes correct prose, punctuation and typographical wording. Neither version has the later floor-endpoint or rounding-bound corrections.

Section 3 opening adds the Matoušek–Rödl acknowledgment, the Forbidden intersections reference, and revised quantitative comparison with Frankl–Rödl. Lemma 3.5 changes positive j to nonnegative j, 0<x-y to 0<=x-y, and the rounding bound n0^3/n^2 to 2n0^2/n^2. The funding acknowledgment is expanded. The main enclosure and proof architecture are unchanged.

All seven manuscript pages and eight published pages visually compared. The sequential published labels 1–11 replace 1.1,1.2,3.1–3.9; equations (3.1)–(3.4) become (1)–(4). Publication dates, affiliation, license, layout and reference formatting change. The displayed proof construction, v3 rounding correction, and still-insufficient Lemma 7 threshold agree. The publisher abstract is phrased differently from the PDF abstract; neither is substituted for the other.

source_precision.issue: n>=2*pi*n0^3/delta alone need not make the floor map injective or even guarantee a valid polygon order. Ten points j/3 with 0<=j<=9, n0=3, delta=100,n=2 are allowed, but m=8 cannot receive an injection.

source_precision.source: Published Lemma4 p.4 and Proposition11 p.7

source_precision.replacement: Use the displayed identities for distinct labels and handle diagonal zero separately.

source_precision.issue: The coordinate proof invokes a lemma requiring at least two projected points.
source_precision.replacement: Map singleton projections to one polygon vertex and choose a common n0 for all other coordinate distances.

source_precision.issue: Almost regularity of the residual array is asserted without the bound.
source_precision.replacement: With delta=alpha^2/n^2 and n>=2, the deficit sum is <alpha^2(n-1)/n<alpha^2-delta<A^2.

source_precision.issue: Only a Schoenberg/Frankl–Rödl proof pointer is printed.
source_precision.replacement: Full relative deduction from the existing finite Gram criterion using a uniform strict margin and subtraction alpha^2<2*gamma.

source_precision.replacement: Label each pair factor by the partition identifying exactly that pair; a maximizing pair contributes no factor.
